name: paper-wobble
title: Paper Wobble
description: Per-pose reshoot jitter that makes any content feel hand-placed on a desk.
useWhen: Any block should carry the stop-motion reshoot wobble: headlines, cards, or content that must feel hand-placed rather than laid out.
Two or more elements should read as separate objects on a desk: give each its own seed.
avoidWhen: The content should sit rock-still: UI simulations, code blocks being read.
You want smooth floating motion rather than discrete poses.
The component already jitters itself (paper stickers): wrapping it doubles the shake.
author: Remocn

variables.label: Title
variables.description: Headline that wobbles on its own.

variables.label: Card subtitle
variables.default: Every pose is placed by hand

variables.label: Seed
variables.description: Seed for the jitter; each object gets its own.

variables.label: Frames per pose
variables.description: How many frames each pose is held (30 fps).
